_howTo: Add a testimonial by copying one { quote, who } block below and editing it. Keep quotes short (under ~120 characters). They rotate on the Visitor Center guest book and show up as shoutouts in the pier mailbox. Changes show on the next page load, no rebuild needed.

testimonials.quote: My listing captions write themselves now. I just sip my coffee.
Got two hours of my Tuesday back. Spent them on the river.
The bots never forget a follow-up. I used to forget lunch.
They drafted my newsletter before my latte cooled.
Tiny robots, huge help. Would visit the island again.
Best part? They wave at you on the paths.
